name.title: DP_GNC_DVE_ONTIME_OUTPUT
name.sysdesc: Data product to capture GNC commanded accumulated thruster on-times from the prime PME branch and accelerometer based delta-V estimates for a specified length of time. Intended use cases are Frequency-ID and delta-V reconstruction.

array.sysdesc: Delta-V accelerometer based estimates w/thruster commands to now (32Hz) collected per 8Hz RTI

field.sysdesc: (seconds.subseconds) 32Hz. This was added to eliminate the need to calculate and sync update timestamps with data
Delta-V accelerometer based estimate w/thruster commands to now (1 of 3). Data source is same as used to generate tlm channel GNC_DVE_DV_EST_LAST_MEAS_BF_0 (32Hz).
